data.body: **[P2] Track ambiguous invocations before allowing function reuse.** If Lambda accepts an invocation but its response is lost, this path raises before registering it in `self.invocations`. Per-case teardown cannot stop or observe that execution and skips settlement polling when no other invocations exist. Subsequent cases can therefore reuse an occupied function. Register the marker before invoking, recover matching execution ARNs during teardown, and block reuse until settlement is established. Add a lost-response teardown test.
